prompt: Which statements about Enterprise Managed Users are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: EMU centralizes identity: IdP-provisioned accounts, corporate sign-in, enterprise-managed lifecycle — and those accounts are restricted to the enterprise’s corner of GitHub, not open contributors. Organizations still exist inside it.

options.text: Member accounts are provisioned by the enterprise identity provider
The enterprise governs the accounts’ lifecycle
EMU accounts can contribute to any public repository without restriction
EMU replaces the need for organizations
